description: Use when the user has a photo, screenshot, or image of a loan or credit-card offer letter (or describes a letter they received) and wants to know who sent it, what the offer is, where the response or confirmation code is located, and whether it is worth responding to. Returns a plain-language read of the mailer. LendMail is not a lender and is not affiliated with the company that sent the letter.
